features.note: A distinct square box sits centered on top of the lower body, forming a clear two-tier pass-through-hood silhouette that reads as the raising wash-chamber cover rather than a cabinet. Shape and stacking are convincing; only the dark tone weakens the 'stainless hood' read.

Body and hood render as a flat dark charcoal/gunmetal matte gray, directly violating the spec's 'satin, NOT dark matte' clause — this does not read as brushed 304 stainless (#d2d6d8 satin). The wash-chamber front opening IS present as a dark inset rectangle on the lower-left face, but the surrounding surfaces show almost no satin metallic sheen. The only bright metal is the horizontal handle rail, which reads as chrome and clashes with the dull body.

A front control panel with a green-lit rectangular status display and three round buttons reads clearly as the machine's control interface. It sits slightly low (mid-body) rather than upper operator height, but is legible and correctly located on the front face.

defects: Entire body and hood read as dark matte charcoal gray, not light satin stainless — spec explicitly forbids 'dark matte'; surfaces lack visible brushed-metal sheen.
Overall image is underexposed/dark; large front and side faces fall into near-flat shadow, killing any satin-stainless specular response.
Horizontal handle rail reads as bright chrome, inconsistent with the dull body — mixed metal read (chrome vs matte) instead of uniform brushed 304.
Hood top and body faces show flat even shading with no brushed anisotropy or highlight roll-off to sell stainless.
Control panel is placed low on the body (roughly mid-height) rather than at upper operator height.
corrections: Raise material lightness/roughness balance so body and hood read as satin #d2d6d8 brushed stainless: increase perceived albedo (lighter mid-gray), keep roughness ~0.30, and ensure the house-rig lighting produces a visible soft highlight across the top hood and front faces — eliminate the dark-matte read.
Boost key/fill exposure so the large front and side faces are no longer in near-black shadow; target a clearly metallic satin surface under the 42deg/22deg camera.

Reconcile the handle rail material with the body so it does not read as chrome against a matte body — either bring the body up to matching satin stainless or tone the rail down to the same brushed recipe.
Raise the control panel toward upper operator height on the front face for a more convincing operator-interface read.

mechanical.note: Console clean; draws 14/20 and tris 534/60000 both far under budget. No invariant suite (tests=null).
